metadata.description: Saved Saxlingham XL AutoDrive geometry near the two logged headland-entry targets; directed shortest-distance routes, not an executed AutoDrive simulation.
metadata.routeAlgorithm: Reverse Dijkstra over saved outgoing edges, weighted by Euclidean x/z edge length. Routes include start and destination. AutoDrive turn restrictions and routing preferences are not simulated.
metadata.nodeScope: All nodes within 100 metres of either entry, plus nodes on their routes to the delivery destination. Original outgoing IDs are preserved and may reference nodes outside this fixture.
